text:
finance: Heads-up team: we're shipping three billing/quotas changes next month to reduce invoice surprises and improve auditability. Short list: (1) prorated refunds on plan downgrades, (2) 90-day promo credit expiry (clarified exceptions), (3) "grace hour" for accidental rate-limit bursts for small orgs. Details below.

chris-devrel: quick Q 1: what's the exact definition of "small orgs" for the grace hour?

finance: small orgs = orgs with average monthly invoice < $200 over the last 3 billing cycles. Grace hour applies once per billing cycle and forgives metering for short bursts up to 60 minutes total. It's intended for accidental spikes, not repeated abuse.

rachel-cs: will customers see the grace hour in Console? we need to avoid support tickets where people think charges disappeared.

finance: yes 1  Console will show a "grace usage" line on the billing tab. We'll also add an activity item in the invoice UI indicating "grace applied" when it happens. Support will get an internal FAQ explaining the math.

emily-ops: about prorated refunds  how will the refund be calculated if someone downgrades mid-cycle and used more than the new plan allowance?

finance: refunds are prorated based on days remaining in the billing period and the difference in committed spend. If usage exceeds the new plan allowance, overage pricing applies on the remaining days. We'll provide an "estimate before you downgrade" modal in Console to avoid surprises.

leo-engr: any API changes so customers can simulate these scenarios programmatically?

finance: yes  were adding an invoice preview API query param: `?simulate_downgrade_to=plan_id&as_of=YYYY-MM-DD`. Example: `GET /v1/invoices/preview?simulate_downgrade_to=team-small&as_of=2026-04-01` returns a preview diff. Response exportable as CSV/JSON.

chris-devrel: can we get a short curl sample for the docs?

finance: adding now:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/invoices/preview?simulate_downgrade_to=team-small&as_of=2026-04-01" \
  -o preview.json
jq . preview.json
```

marta-legal: flag: ensure the downgrade/refund UI language matches contract terms for enterprise customers. Custom contracts must remain authoritative and opt-outs documented.

finance: noted. Enterprise exceptions will require an explicit checkbox and sign-off. We'll run the modal copy through legal prior to release.

billing-bot: TIMELINE:
- Day 0: Announcement (today)
- Day 10: API + Console preview for a scoped beta group
- Day 30: Public rollout of prorated refunds and grace hour for qualifying orgs
- Day 45: Promo credit expiry enforcement (90-day rule) for new grants

rachel-cs: for promo credit expiry  are we grandfathering existing startup credits? we've got a lot of partners on older terms.

finance: existing promo credits issued before the announcement get a 120-day grandfather window to provide a migration path. We'll notify affected accounts with explicit expiration dates and provide an extension request flow for active pilots.

leo-engr: ops notes: we'll emit two new metrics `billing.grace_applied` and `billing.proration_preview_count`. Also will add an alert if downgrades with refunds > $5k occur unusually often.

emily-ops: add an audit log entry whenever a refund is issued and include the preview diff ID. That helps CS/Finance reconcile.

finance: agreed. We'll include `preview_id` and `diff_hash` on the invoice and in audit logs.

marta-legal: also ensure regional consumer rules are respected in the email cadence for promo expiries (EU notice windows differ).

finance: yes we'll tailor emails by region and include links to the help center.

chris-devrel: doc asks: can devs opt out of the grace hour? some customers want strict metering for billing analytics.

finance: yes  org-admins can toggle "strict metering" in Console (org settings > billing). Default is grace enabled for qualifying orgs.

billing-bot: ACTION CREATED: BILL-4001 implement invoice preview endpoint and CSV export (owner: eng-billing).

rachel-cs: support playbook request: prepare templates for the 3 most common tickets: credit expired, unexpected refund, and grace applied.

finance: will create templates and a quick-runbook for CS. Drafts will be in /docs/support/billing-playbook.md.

leo-engr: one more technical: ensure multi-region usage is normalized for the "small org" calc (use USD-converted rolling average).

finance: yep, normalization using invoice currency conversion at the monthly close.

finance: OK folks, we'll post the draft help center articles and the Console mockups in #product-design for review by EOD Friday. Thanks for the rapid feedback. End of thread.
